title: सूरज छुपते ही गायब हो जाती है गाँव की परछाई
topic: एक अनोखा गाँव जहाँ सूरज ढलते ही जमीन पर इंसानों की परछाइयां गायब हो जाती हैं और नन्हा रोहन इसका राज ढूंढने निकलता है।
description:
सोचिए अगर शाम होते ही आपकी अपनी परछाई आपको छोड़कर गायब हो जाए तो क्या होगा? जानिए नन्हीं समझदारी और एक अनोखे रहस्य की यह जादुई कहानी।
#KahaniPatang #KidsStories #MagicStory #HindiKahani #MysteryStory

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: ज़रा सोचिए... आप धूप में खड़े हैं, लेकिन ज़मीन पर आपकी परछाई है ही नहीं! क्या ऐसा मुमकिन है?
scenes.style: warm, gentle storyteller, raising eyebrows with curiosity
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, standing alone in a sunny village courtyard in India, looking down at the ground in complete shock where his shadow is missing, bright afternoon sunlight, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अरे नहीं, यह कोई मज़ाक नहीं है! यह सच है 'अंधेरापुर' गाँव का एक बहुत बड़ा और अजीब रहस्य।
scenes.style: mysterious, slightly lowered voice to build tension
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, standing near old mud houses in a quiet Indian village as dusk begins to fall, holding a small wooden stick, medium shot, cinematic twilight lighting.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: नन्हा रोहन जब शाम को अपने घर लौट रहा था, तो उसने ज़मीन पर ध्यान दिया।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, walking along a dusty village path in India during sunset, looking intently at the ground, medium shot, warm orange and purple sky.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अरे! सूरज ढलते ही उसकी परछाई अचानक गायब हो चुकी थी! क्या आप जानते हैं ऐसा क्यों हुआ?
scenes.style: surprised, gasping slightly with sudden fear
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, standing under a giant banyan tree in an Indian village, looking down in terror at his feet where no shadow exists, dramatic side lighting, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रोहन ने डरकर चारों तरफ देखा। पूरे गाँव में किसी की भी परछाई नज़र नहीं आ रही थी!
scenes.style: whispering, as if sharing a secret in the dark
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, looking around a deserted village square in India at twilight, eerie atmosphere, no shadows on the ground anywhere, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: तभी गाँव के बीचों-बीच बने पुराने कुएँ से एक अजीब सी नीली रोशनी बाहर चमकने लगी।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, standing a few feet away from an ancient stone well in an Indian village courtyard, bright magical blue light glowing from inside the well, dark twilight background, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सोचिए, अगर आप रोहन की जगह होते, तो क्या आप उस कुएँ के पास जाते?
scenes.style: direct question to audience, friendly and engaging
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, biting his lower lip in hesitation while looking towards the glowing stone well in an Indian village, dramatic blue glow illuminating his face, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रोहन डरा ज़रूर, लेकिन उसने हिम्मत जुटाई और धीरे-धीरे कुएँ की तरफ बढ़ने लगा।
scenes.style: cautious, slow pacing with soft footsteps sound feel
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, taking tiptoe steps forward on the stone pavement towards the glowing village well, focused and brave expression, medium shot, night setting.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: जैसे ही वह कुएँ के पास पहुँचा, नीली रोशनी और तेज़ हो गई और एक आवाज़ गूँजी!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, standing right at the edge of the ancient stone well, shielding his eyes from the intense blue light bursting upwards, dynamic angle shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आवाज़ बोली—'जो अपनी परछाई वापस चाहता है, उसे चाँद को छूना होगा!'
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, looking straight up into the starry Indian night sky towards the bright full moon, astonished expression, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चाँद को छूना? भला यह कैसे संभव है? रोहन ने आसमान में देखा और एक तरکیب सूझी।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, tapping his chin thoughtfully with a smart smile, standing near his house in the Indian village, medium shot, moonlight.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रोहन भागा और घर से एक बड़ा सा आईना ले आया और कुएँ के पानी के सामने रख दिया।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, carefully placing a large shiny mirror right at the rim of the ancient stone well in the Indian village, action shot, medium close-up.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आईने में चमकते हुए चाँद की पूरी परछाई कुएँ के अंदर उतर गई!
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, smiling brightly as the mirror reflects the bright moon straight down into the well water, magical glowing sparkles, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चमत्कार हो गया! कुएँ से नीला जादू वापस आसमान में फैल गया और सबकी परछाइयाँ लौट आईं।
scenes.visual: Precise English visual prompt, about 50 words: 7-year-old Rohan, round cheerful face, big expressive dark eyes, short messy black hair, wearing bright yellow cotton t-shirt and blue shorts, jumping with joy in the village square as shadows magically reappear on the ground under the moonlight, wide shot, festive village background.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रोहन की समझदारी से पूरा गाँव बच गया। सीख यही है—मुश्किल वक्त में डरने के बजाय दिमाग लगाना चाहिए!
scenes.style: warm, encouraging and happy storyteller tone
